text_block_list.text:
It's still red after all...
Maybe this moisturizing cream isn't right for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely because I just bought it
for the cover art, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know I should choose based on my skin type,
but still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haaah... If only there was a skin cream in cute packaging that suited my skin...
Mejiro Dober seems to be suffering from skin trouble...
